name: dashdrop
description: DashDrop — spreadsheet-native SaaS dashboard for SMB owners

scripts.build: node scripts/db-provider.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.generated.prisma && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-build next build
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/db-provider.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.generated.prisma && next build
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/db-provider.mjs && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.generated.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/db-provider.mjs && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.generated.prisma && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.generated.prisma
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
